svg.text: STAGE 388 · TOPIC 28 FAQ
PSTN TrFO Fricative Preservation & RTP Clock-Drift ASRC Resynchronization
3GPP TS 23.153 TrFO >=16kHz Wideband + 3–6dB Fricative Boost (P769) & Kalman ASRC <=±50ppm Clock-Skew Resync (P770)
1. PSTN/VoLTE TrFO & Fricative Consonants Preservation Gate (P769)
❌ Anti-Pattern: AMR-WB (16kHz) -> G.711 (8kHz) -> Opus Tandem Transcoding
• Legacy TDM/SBC downgrades VoLTE 16kHz HD Voice to 8kHz G.711 (3.4kHz brick-wall)
• Strips 4kHz–7kHz unvoiced fricatives: "Fifty" (F) sounds identical to "Sixty" (S)
• Result: 23.5% F/S & B/D confusion rate on postal codes, names, and amounts
✅ Production Pattern: 3GPP TrFO Wideband + 3–6dB Fricative Shelf (P769)
1. 3GPP TS 23.153 TrFO: Negotiate end-to-end AMR-WB / EVS (>=16kHz) on SIP trunks
2. Zero Tandem Law-Conversion: Forbid unnecessary G.711 μ-law <-> A-law re-quantization
3. Narrowband Compensation: Apply +3.0 to +6.0dB 2.8–3.8kHz high-shelf pre-emphasis
4. Phonetic Slot Guard: Cuts F/S & B/D consonant error rate from 23.5% to 1.4%
Deterministic Invariant (evaluatePstnAmrWbG711TandemTranscoding...):
negotiatedSampleRateHz >= 16000 && fricativePreEmphasisGainDb in [3.0, 6.0]
2. RTP Clock-Drift ASRC & WSOLA Underrun Click Prevention (P770)
❌ Anti-Pattern: Uncompensated Quartz Crystal Skew (+120ppm) & Zero-Fill Pops
• Low-cost IoT/car mic clock runs at 48,005.8 Hz vs. cloud TTS 48,000.0 Hz (+120ppm)
• Drifts 7.2ms/min: either overflows jitter buffer (+450ms lag) or starves every 35s
• Result: Audible PCM step-function clicks & AEC tail reference desynchronization
✅ Production Pattern: Kalman Clock-Skew ASRC & WSOLA Splice (P770)
1. Continuous Skew Tracking: Estimate crystal drift via RTCP SR / RTP arrival Kalman
2. Polyphase ASRC Resync: Dynamically fractional-resample within <=±50ppm tolerance
3. WSOLA Pitch-Synchronous PLC: Conceal <=15ms underruns at zero-crossings (0 clicks)
4. AEC Reference Lock: Preserves acoustic echo canceller convergence over 60m+ calls
Deterministic Invariant (evaluateRtpJitterBufferClockDriftAsrc...):
maxResidualClockDriftPpm <= 50 && maxWsolaUnderrunWindowMs <= 15ms
Stage 388 Quantitative Verification & Measurement Provenance (391 Dimensions · 779 Guardrails · 788 Probes · 830 Unit Tests)
• TrFO Gate (P769): Cuts F/S & B/D consonant WER from 23.5% to 1.4%; Clock-Drift ASRC Gate (P770): Eliminates periodic underrun clicks & +450ms drift bloat.
